entries.name: Iskander Mirza
entries.summary: Pakistan ke pehle President; is se pehle aakhri Governor-General the.
facts: 23 March 1956 ko Pakistan republic bana aur presidential office shuru hua. Quaid-e-Azam pehle Governor-General the, President nahin.
7 October 1958 ko pehla martial law lagaya; 27 October ko Ayub Khan un ki jagah President bane.
Yahan handover ki tareekh 27 October hai; Cabinet ki historical list end date 26 October dikhati hai.

entries.name: Muhammad Ayub Khan
entries.summary: Pakistan ke doosre President; 1962 ka presidential Constitution un ke daur mein aaya.
facts: 19 September 1960 ke Indus Waters Treaty par Pakistan ki taraf se Ayub Khan ne dastakhat kiye; India ki taraf se PM Jawaharlal Nehru the.
Cabinet list end 24 March 1969 dikhati hai; yahan Presidency aur NA ki 25 March handover date hai.

entries.name: Agha Muhammad Yahya Khan
entries.summary: Pakistan ke teesre President; 1970 ke pehle aam intikhabat un ke daur mein hue.
facts: National Assembly ke pehle adult-franchise general elections 7 December 1970 ko hue.
20 December 1971 ko Zulfikar Ali Bhutto ne presidency sambhali; Cabinet list Yahya ki end date 19 December dikhati hai.

entries.name: Zulfikar Ali Bhutto
entries.summary: Pakistan ke chauthe President; baad mein Wazir-e-Azam bane.
facts: 20 December 1971 ko pehle civilian Chief Martial Law Administrator bhi bane.
14 August 1973 ko naye Constitution ke tehat PM bane; Fazal Elahi Chaudhry ne presidency sambhali.

entries.name: Fazal Elahi Chaudhry
entries.summary: Pakistan ke paanchwein President; 1973 ke Constitution ke tehat pehle President.
facts: Bhutto ke PM banne ke din presidency sambhali; un ke baad Zia-ul-Haq President bane.
Yahan NA ki mukammal presidency aur 16 September handover date hai. Cabinet list end date 15 September dikhati hai; Presidency website 1978 ke kuch periods alag dikhati hai.

entries.name: Muhammad Zia-ul-Haq
entries.summary: Pakistan ke chhatay President; presidency 1978 se thi, martial-law takeover 1977 mein hua tha.
facts: 5 July 1977 ke martial law aur 16 September 1978 ko President banne ki tareekhon ko alag yaad rakhein.
17 August 1988 ko Bahawalpur ke qareeb plane crash mein wafat hui; Ghulam Ishaq Khan ne acting zimmedari sambhali.

entries.name: Ghulam Ishaq Khan
entries.summary: Pakistan ke saatwein President; pehle acting, phir muntakhib President bane.
facts: Cabinet record acting phase aur elected phase ko alag karta hai; dono yahan ek hi shakhs ke neeche hain, do alag Presidents nahin.
End date 18 July 1993 Presidency aur Cabinet dono se tasdeeq hai; NA summary ki 8 July entry is se mukhtalif hai.

entries.name: Farooq Ahmad Khan Leghari
entries.summary: Pakistan ke aathwein President; un ke dono taraf Wasim Sajjad ke acting daur aaye.
facts: 5 November 1996 ko Benazir Bhutto ke doosre daur ki National Assembly barkhast ki.
Presidency ki handover date 2 December 1997 hai; Cabinet list end date 1 December likhti hai.

entries.name: Muhammad Rafiq Tarar
entries.summary: Pakistan ke nauwein President; pehle Lahore High Court ke Chief Justice aur Supreme Court judge rahe.
facts: 1998 ke naye saal ke pehle din presidency sambhali; un ke baad Pervez Musharraf aaye.
Yahan Presidency ki 20 June handover date hai; Cabinet list end date 19 June dikhati hai.

entries.name: Pervez Musharraf
entries.summary: Pakistan ke daswein President; 1999 ka Chief Executive takeover aur 2001 ki presidency alag dates hain.
facts: 29 November 2007 ko civilian President ke taur par dobara halaf liya; yahan poori 2001–2008 service ek musalsal daur mein hai.
18 August 2008 ko isteefa diya. NA summary mein 2007 ke do hisse hain; Presidency ki list mukammal 20 June 2001–18 August 2008 muddat deti hai.

entries.name: Asif Ali Zardari

tenures.label: Doosra daur — 14wein President; halaf ki tareekh

entries.summary: 21 October 2026 ki verification par mojooda President; 2008–2013 ke baad doosra ghair-musalsal daur.
facts: 2024 mein intikhab 9 March ko hua; halaf aur office sambhalne ki tareekh 10 March hai.
Presidency unhein 14wein President kehti hai. Is list mein ek shakhs ka naam ek hi martaba hai; un ke dono daur neeche saath diye hain.
Pehle daur ka handover 9 September 2013 tha; Cabinet ki historical list end date 8 September dikhati hai.

entries.name: Mamnoon Hussain
entries.summary: Pakistan ke barhwein President; Zardari ke pehle daur ke baad aur Arif Alvi se pehle aaye.
facts: 2013–2018 ka paanch saala daur yaad rakhein.
NA aur Presidency handover 9 September 2018 dikhati hain; Cabinet ki historical list end 8 September hai.

entries.name: Dr Arif-ur-Rehman Alvi
entries.summary: Pakistan ke terhwein President; un ke baad Zardari ka doosra daur shuru hua.
facts: 2018–2024 ki asal service ko sirf 2018–2023 na samjhein: successor ka halaf 10 March 2024 ko hua.
Arif Alvi aur Zardari ke handover ki 10 March 2024 tareekh Presidency ke record aur Gazette se milti hai.

entries.name: Wasim Sajjad

tenures.label: Pehla acting daur — NA handover dates

entries.summary: Senate Chairman ki haisiyat se do martaba Acting President; yeh regular presidential numbering mein shamil nahin.
facts: Pehli martaba Ghulam Ishaq Khan ke baad, doosri martaba Farooq Leghari ke baad zimmedari sambhali.
Pehle daur ke liye NA 18 July–14 November 1993 deta hai, jabke Senate profile 19 July–13 November deti hai. Yahan NA ki handover dates dikhayi gayi hain.
Acting ka matlab aarzi zimmedari hai; ise caretaker Prime Minister ke ohday se alag yaad rakhein.

entries.name: Muhammad Mian Soomro
entries.summary: Musharraf ke isteefay ke baad aur Zardari ke pehle halaf se pehle Acting President.
facts: Senate Chairman bhi rahe; presidency ki aarzi muddat 2008 ki hai.
2007–2008 mein caretaker Prime Minister bhi the; caretaker PM aur Acting President un ki do alag zimmedariyan thin.
